definitions.explanation: The pair of fins on each side of a fish's body just behind the head, used for steering and balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胸|むな}びれ。
⟦トビウオ→トビウオ：32382_tobiuo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{胸|むな}びれ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Flying fish glide through the air on their large pectoral fins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{胸|むな}びれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かして→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧、⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{変|か}えている→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Fish move their pectoral fins to make small changes in the direction they swim.

notes:
